headline: South Korea Expands Account Freeze Powers for Cryptocurrency Financial Crimes
summary: South Korean authorities proposed measures expanding their financial account suspension system to cover major cryptocurrency fraud and restrict unauthorized overseas transfers.
why: South Korea is a key hub for global retail cryptocurrency exchange liquidity.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: South Korea announced expanded powers to freeze crypto-related bank accounts.
